decisions.reason: The selected battery-connector part preserves the existing three-pin interface including NTC and does not change the thermal-monitoring behavior.
The battery-connector part selection does not affect charge-status display through the SK6812 LED chain.
The connector selection does not change the AXP2101 electrical-protection behavior or cutoff settings.
The battery-connector update does not change the switchable 5V boost rail, its GPIO control, or its powered loads.
The sourcing concern concerns the battery and 13-pin connectors, not the independently selected USB-C connector.
Selecting the battery-connector part does not alter the confirmed placement, orientation, mounting-hole clearance, or access requirements.
The client raises splitting the 13-pin interboard connection into power and signal connectors as a question, but does not confirm a new interface design in this message.
The battery-connector selection does not change the SK6812 LED family, power interface, or data GPIO.
The battery-connector update does not affect native USB D+ and D- connectivity.
The source does not revise the power-board dimensions, orientation, mounting holes, aspect ratio, or USB-C edge placement.
